provenance.canonical-source: apps/v4/registry/new-york-v4/ui/select.tsx — ten exported parts (Select, SelectGroup, SelectValue, SelectTrigger, SelectContent, SelectLabel, SelectItem, SelectSeparator, SelectScrollUpButton, SelectScrollDownButton) over radix-ui's Select primitive. Every STYLE value below comes from this file. primitives/packages/react/select/src/select.tsx was read for BEHAVIOR only (role vocabulary, OPEN_KEYS/SELECTION_KEYS, the 1000ms typeahead reset, the item-aligned vs popper position modes, data-highlighted/data-state/data-placeholder), never for a style cell. Examples cross-checked: examples/select-demo.tsx, select-scrollable.tsx, field-select.tsx; docs content/docs/components/radix/select.mdx (its 'Align Item With Trigger', 'Groups', 'Disabled' and 'Invalid' sections).
provenance.scroll-buttons-scope-trim: SelectScrollUpButton / SelectScrollDownButton (flex cursor-default items-center justify-center py-1, each holding a size-4 chevron) are a SCROLL AFFORDANCE unique to shadcn/Radix — Salt scrolls the list natively (overflow-y: auto) and M3 has no such token. Declared out of scope rather than modelled as a part, the same trim TOOLTIP-MATRIX.md made for floating-ui placement values.
provenance.field-bg: class `bg-transparent` (light) + `dark:bg-input/30`. Tailwind v4 compiles the /30 modifier to color-mix(in oklab, var(--input) 30%, transparent); --input in dark is oklch(1 0 0 / 15%) (globals.css:161). Identical derivation to input.shadcn.json.
provenance.field-bg-hover: class `dark:hover:bg-input/50`. THIS IS THE ROW WHERE SELECT DIVERGES FROM SHADCN'S OWN INPUT: input.tsx has no hover: class of any kind (input.shadcn.json's no-hover provenance entry, INPUT-MATRIX.md finding 5), but select.tsx does — in dark mode only. The light value is recorded as `transparent`, i.e. the sourced non-change, so the mode split lives in the slots block rather than being smuggled into a cell.
provenance.fg: SelectTrigger sets no text-colour class, so the value text is the ambient --foreground (globals.css:102 light / :145 dark). Recorded as an ambient inheritance, not as a component token.
provenance.fg-secondary: --muted-foreground (globals.css:112 / :155). THREE consumers in this one file: data-[placeholder]:text-muted-foreground on the trigger, [&_svg:not([class*='text-'])]:text-muted-foreground (which the chevron matches), and SelectLabel's text-muted-foreground.
provenance.border-base: class `border border-input` on the trigger -> --input (globals.css:118 / :161). The bare `border` utility supplies the 1px width, which Tailwind does not tokenise (docs/foundations/border-style.md).
provenance.popup-border: SelectContent's bare `border` utility with NO colour class -> --border (globals.css:117 / :160). Deliberately a different slot from border-base: --border and --input are the same value in light (oklch(0.922 0 0)) but DIFFERENT in dark (10% vs 15% white), so a shadcn popup's frame is fainter than its trigger's in dark mode. Also the SelectSeparator's bg-border.
provenance.popup-bg / popup-fg: SelectContent `bg-popover text-popover-foreground` -> --popover / --popover-foreground (globals.css:105-106 / :148-149). A dedicated popover role, distinct from --background.
provenance.accent-bg / accent-fg: SelectItem `focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground` -> --accent / --accent-foreground (globals.css:113-114 / :156-157). Reached through :focus, not :hover, because Radix moves real DOM focus onto the item on pointermove and on arrow keys.
provenance.focus: trigger classes focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 -> --ring (globals.css:119 / :162). The /50 modifier is carried by ring-alpha so the aria-invalid override can change only the alpha.
provenance.danger: aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 -> --destructive (globals.css:115 / :158). Same two-alpha structure as input.shadcn.json.
provenance.radius-control / radius-popup / radius-o: rounded-md on both the trigger and SelectContent -> --radius-md = calc(var(--radius) * 0.8) = 8px; rounded-sm on SelectItem -> --radius-sm = calc(var(--radius) * 0.6) = 6px (globals.css:50-51, --radius: 0.625rem at :100). shadcn is the ONLY system that rounds an individual option.
provenance.shadow-color: trigger class shadow-xs = 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05). Reused verbatim from button.shadcn.json / input.shadcn.json rather than re-derived; Tailwind is not vendored in this clone.
provenance.popup-shadow: SelectContent class shadow-md. [R] — Tailwind's documented default two-layer value; the package is not vendored, so this is the same unvendored-package caveat as shadow-xs, and it is the first shadow-md this registry has needed (docs/foundations/elevation.md records only that shadcn uses bare utility classes, undeclared).
provenance.type-body: trigger class `text-sm` = 0.875rem/1.25rem, and SelectItem carries the same `text-sm`. NOTE this is a FLAT text-sm, not the responsive `text-base md:text-sm` shadcn's Input uses — so the missing-@media generator gap INPUT-MATRIX.md finding 9 declared does not apply to select. Family read as the generic Tailwind sans stack per button/input/tooltip precedent (no font-family utility is set anywhere in select.tsx).
provenance.type-group-label: SelectLabel class `text-xs` = 0.75rem/1rem with NO font-weight utility, so the ambient 400 applies — a shadcn group label is smaller than its options but not bolder, the exact inverse of Salt's semiBold label.
provenance.size-prop: SelectTrigger takes `size?: "sm" | "default"` (default "default"), writes data-size, and drives data-[size=default]:h-9 (36px) / data-[size=sm]:h-8 (32px). shadcn's Input has NO size prop — this is a real select-only axis.
provenance.item-aligned-default: SelectContent's `position` defaults to "item-aligned", Radix's native-select-like mode in which the popup is placed so the SELECTED item lands over the trigger. The popper (below-the-trigger) mode is opt-in and brings its own translate-y-1 offsets and the min-w-[var(--radix-select-trigger-width)] viewport rule. The docs page states this explicitly in its 'Align Item With Trigger' section.
provenance.no-hover-on-item: CONFIRMED ABSENCE: SelectItem has no hover: class of any kind. Its highlight is focus:bg-accent, because Radix focuses the item element on pointermove — the appearance of a hover, produced by a focus rule.
provenance.no-selected-background: CONFIRMED ABSENCE: there is no data-[state=checked] class anywhere in select.tsx. A selected shadcn item is marked ONLY by the CheckIcon inside SelectPrimitive.ItemIndicator; its background is unchanged. This is the mechanism split structure.selected-marker exists to carry.
provenance.no-readonly-no-variant-no-status-beyond-: Radix's Select has no readOnly prop; shadcn adds no background-intensity variant; and the whole validation axis is the single aria-invalid boolean — no warning, no success. The same coverage gap already recorded for button, alert and input.
provenance.disabled-has-no-pointer-events-none: select.tsx's trigger carries `disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50` and NOT the `disabled:pointer-events-none` its own input.tsx carries. Recorded as a sourced difference, not normalised away.
provenance.transition-defaults: class transition-[color,box-shadow] — property list sourced [S]; 150ms / cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) are Tailwind's defaults and Tailwind is not vendored, so [R].
provenance.animation-defaults: SelectContent composes tw-animate-css: data-[state=open]:animate-in fade-in-0 zoom-in-95 (+ per-side slide-in-from-*) and the closing mirror. The package is listed as a dependency but its CSS is not vendored in this clone, so 150ms / ease-out are [R] — the same caveat TOOLTIP-MATRIX.md recorded. The keyframe select-popup-in is appended to page/chrome.css.

structure.indicator.note: structurally always a full border — not a runtime prop and not a variant. There is no underline/activation-indicator mechanism anywhere in select.tsx.

structure.start-adornment.note: SelectTrigger renders {children} followed by a fixed SelectPrimitive.Icon and has no leading slot. A consumer can put an icon inside SelectValue's children, but that is consumer content, not a component part.

structure.status-adornment.note: no validation glyph concept at all

structure.toggle-icon.source: select.tsx <SelectPrimitive.Icon asChild><ChevronDownIcon className="size-4 opacity-50" /></SelectPrimitive.Icon> — one glyph, never swapped, never conditional

structure.selected-marker.source: select.tsx SelectItem renders , and every item reserves pr-8 for it

structure.popup-anchor.source: select.tsx SelectContent `position = "item-aligned"` default — see the item-aligned-default provenance entry and the docs page's 'Align Item With Trigger' section

behavior.pointer-activates-option.source: Radix select.tsx focuses the item element on pointermove, which is precisely why shadcn styles the highlight with focus: rather than hover:

behavior.status-inheritance.note: no context channel — the docs' Invalid section tells the consumer to put data-invalid on Field AND aria-invalid on SelectTrigger by hand

behavior.readonly-suppresses-popup.note: Radix's Select has no readOnly prop at all — unlike shadcn's Input, where the native attribute at least exists with no styling

behavior.multiselect.note: Radix's Select is single-choice only; there is no `multiple` prop

prop.size.source: select.tsx SelectTrigger size?: "sm" | "default" = "default" -> data-size -> data-[size=default]:h-9 / data-[size=sm]:h-8

prop.validation-status.note: a single boolean (aria-invalid), not an enum — no warning, no success

prop.disabled.source: select.tsx disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 on the trigger; data-[disabled]:pointer-events-none data-[disabled]:opacity-50 on the item

style.trigger.background@box.note: box is shadcn's only mode; already covered by style.trigger.background

style.trigger.color.note: ambient --foreground; SelectTrigger sets no text-colour class

style.trigger.width.source: select.tsx SelectTrigger `w-fit` — shadcn's trigger is sized to its content, not to its container; every example that wants a fixed width passes className="w-[180px]"

style.trigger.min-height.source: select.tsx data-[size=default]:h-9; density-invariant (shadcn has no density capability)

style.trigger.min-width.note: no min-width utility — w-fit alone sizes the trigger

style.trigger.padding.source: select.tsx px-3 py-2 — note py-2, where shadcn's own Input is py-1

style.trigger.gap.source: select.tsx gap-2, a real flex gap (Salt uses margins for the same job)

style.trigger.shape@box.note: box is the only mode; already covered by style.trigger.shape

style.trigger.cursor.note: no cursor utility at rest — a <button> already shows the platform default

style.trigger.transition.note: property list [S]; duration and easing [R] — Tailwind defaults, package not vendored

style.trigger.border@box.source: select.tsx `border border-input`; the 1px width is Tailwind's undeclared default

style.indicator.border@underline.note: no underline mechanism of any kind

style.trigger.background@hover.source: select.tsx dark:hover:bg-input/50 — a DARK-MODE-ONLY hover, and the one place shadcn's select reacts to the pointer where its input does not at all

style.trigger.border@box-hover.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — the only hover: utility in select.tsx is the dark background above; the border never changes on hover

style.trigger.border@box-focus.source: select.tsx focus-visible:border-ring — recolour only, width unchanged

value.box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring-current) var(--ring-alpha-current), transparent), 0 1px 2px 0 var(--shadow-color)

style.trigger.focus.source: select.tsx outline-none + focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50. The shadow-xs layer is repeated after the ring because Tailwind v4 composes box-shadow as `var(--tw-ring-shadow), var(--tw-shadow)` — a single-layer box-shadow here would silently delete the trigger's shadow.

style.trigger.background@disabled.note: one blanket opacity:0.5 does the whole job

style.trigger.disabled.note: NOTE the absence of pointer-events:none, which shadcn's own input.tsx does carry — a sourced difference between two shadcn components, recorded rather than normalised

style.value.placeholder.source: select.tsx data-[placeholder]:text-muted-foreground — colour only, and stamped by Radix on the TRIGGER (data-placeholder), not on the value span

style.toggle-icon.color.source: select.tsx: the chevron's only classes are size-4 and opacity-50, so it matches the trigger's [&_svg:not([class*='text-'])]:text-muted-foreground group rule AND carries its own opacity-50 — two dimming mechanisms stacked

style.popup.color.source: select.tsx SelectContent text-popover-foreground; the item inherits it

style.popup.border.source: select.tsx SelectContent bare `border` -> --border, NOT the --input token its trigger uses; the two diverge in dark mode (10% vs 15% white)

style.popup.shape.source: select.tsx SelectContent rounded-md — the same 8px as its trigger, unlike Salt which uses a rounder stop for the popup

style.popup.shadow.source: select.tsx SelectContent shadow-md; [R] value, see the popup-shadow provenance entry

style.popup.padding.source: select.tsx SelectPrimitive.Viewport className="p-1" — the inset that gives the rounded item highlight somewhere to sit

style.popup.gap.note: no gap utility — shadcn's items stack flush

style.popup.min-width.source: select.tsx SelectContent min-w-[8rem] = 128px, a fixed floor independent of the trigger (the trigger-width variable is applied only in position="popper", which is not the default)

style.popup.max-height.note: max-h-(--radix-select-content-available-height) is entirely Popper-computed — the positioning-engine gap, not a token

style.popup.z-index.source: select.tsx SelectContent z-50 — a bare Tailwind stacking index, not a declared token

style.popup.animation.note: duration and easing [R] — tw-animate-css is a declared dependency but its CSS is not vendored in this clone; the utility list (animate-in fade-in-0 zoom-in-95 + per-side slide-in) IS sourced

style.option.background.source: select.tsx SelectItem has no background class at rest

style.option.color.note: inherits the popup's text-popover-foreground; no separate token

style.option.font.source: select.tsx SelectItem text-sm — the same size as its trigger

style.option.min-height.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — SelectItem has no height class; 6px + 6px padding around a 20px line box makes it content-driven

style.option.padding.source: select.tsx SelectItem py-1.5 pr-8 pl-2 — the asymmetric right padding is the reserved lane for the checkmark and exists only because of structure.selected-marker

style.option.shape.source: select.tsx SelectItem rounded-sm — shadcn is the only system that rounds an individual option

style.option.cursor.source: select.tsx SelectItem `cursor-default` — explicitly NOT a pointer, the native-menu convention; Salt uses pointer for the same element

style.option.background@hover.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — there is no hover: class on SelectItem. Radix focuses the item on pointermove, so the focus rule below produces the hover appearance.

style.option.active.source: select.tsx SelectItem focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground — the only system that also changes the TEXT colour when an option is highlighted

style.option.focus-visible.note: SelectItem carries outline-hidden and relies entirely on the background swap

style.option.selected.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no data-[state=checked] class exists anywhere in select.tsx. A selected shadcn item is marked ONLY by the checkmark; its background is identical to an unselected one. This is the whole point of structure.selected-marker.

style.selected-marker.box.source: select.tsx <span data-slot="select-item-indicator" className="absolute right-2 flex size-3.5 items-center justify-center"> holding a size-4 (16px) CheckIcon — a 14px box around a 16px glyph, as written

style.group-label.font.source: select.tsx SelectLabel text-xs with no weight utility

style.group-label.color.source: select.tsx SelectLabel text-muted-foreground — the same token as its placeholder

style.group-label.padding.source: select.tsx SelectLabel px-2 py-1.5 — half an item's vertical size; a caption, not a row

style.group.border-top.note: shadcn divides groups with a dedicated SelectSeparator element, not a border on the group — see style.separator

style.separator.source: select.tsx SelectSeparator `pointer-events-none -mx-1 my-1 h-px bg-border` — the negative inline margins make the rule bleed through the viewport's own 4px padding so it touches both edges

style.trigger.status@error.source: select.tsx aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 — border and ring only; background, popup and options are untouched

style.trigger.status@warning.note: no warning state exists at all

style.trigger.status@success.note: no success state exists at all
